blockers: The rejection's regression requirement (automated Play Mode coverage proving denied-cast feedback stays visible/active when CurrentMana==0, independent of fillAmount) requires editing Assets/NoSafeCircle/DoorPrototype/Tests/PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs, which is a denied write path for this task. That test coverage was not added and needs to be supplied through whatever path owns that file.
notes: PlayerMana.cs was left unmodified; it already implements ResetMana, CastDenied, and the mana-only public API surface required by AC-001/AC-002/AC-003.

The fix relies on the fill Image's parent already having a background Image component, which is how DoorPrototypeSceneBuilder.cs currently constructs the ManaFill/Fill hierarchy (background + child Filled Image); no scene or builder file was modified.

Existing PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs UI tests construct a bare Image with no parent, so ResolveFeedbackImage falls back to the fill Image itself in those tests, preserving their pass/fail behavior unchanged.
structured_output.summary: Fixed the rejected denied-cast feedback defect in PlayerManaUI.cs: the flash now targets an always-visible background/frame Image (the fill Image's parent, as built by DoorPrototypeSceneBuilder's ManaFill/Fill hierarchy) when present, falling back to the fill Image itself otherwise. This keeps feedback readable when CurrentMana==0 (fillAmount 0, no fill pixels to recolor) without any scene/builder changes, and preserves the existing tests' reflection-based normalColor/deniedColor field contract. PlayerMana.cs already satisfied AC-001 (ResetMana)/AC-002 (CastDenied)/AC-003 (mana-only public surface) and required no changes.
